## Deployment Procedure

1. First, verify all tests pass in the CI pipeline.
2. Then, build the Docker image with the release tag.
3. Push the image to the container registry.
4. Update the deployment manifest with the new image tag.
5. Apply the manifest to the Kubernetes cluster.
6. Verify the pods are running and healthy.
7. Run smoke tests against the staging environment.
8. Notify the team that deployment is complete.

## Rollback Procedure

1. Identify the previous working deployment version.
2. Update the manifest to reference the old image tag.
3. Apply the rollback manifest to the cluster.
4. Verify pods restart with the correct version.
5. Confirm application functionality is restored.
6. Document the rollback reason in the incident log.
